parameters.name: DataDisk
parameters.description: The information about data disk types.

sub_parameters.name: Category
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the data disk. Specify this parameter to query the price of a new subscription data disk attached to an ECS instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 16. Valid values:

- cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
- cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
- cloud_essd: enterprise SSD.
- cloud: basic disk.

Default value: null.

> When you call this operation, the instance type parameter (`InstanceType`) and the data disk parameters (`DataDisk.N.*`) cannot both be empty. Specify at least one of them.

sub_parameters.name: DiskId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the data disk.

sub_parameters.name: PerformanceLevel
sub_parameters.description:
The performance level of the data disk when the disk type is enterprise SSD. The value of N must be the same as that in `DataDisk.N.Category=cloud_essd`. Valid values:

- PL0: A single disk can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
- PL1: A single disk can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
- PL2: A single disk can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
- PL3: A single disk can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS.

Default value: PL1.

For information about how to select an ESSD performance level, see [ESSD](~~122389~~).

sub_parameters.name: Size
sub_parameters.description:
The capacity of the data disk. Valid values of N: 1 to 16. Unit: GiB. Valid values:

- cloud_efficiency: 20 to 32768.
- cloud_ssd: 20 to 32768.
- cloud_essd: The valid value range depends on the value of `DataDisk.N.PerformanceLevel`.    
    - PL0: 1 to 32768.
    - PL1: 20 to 32768.
    - PL2: 461 to 32768.
    - PL3: 1261 to 32768.
- cloud: 5 to 2000.

Default value: the minimum capacity for the specified data disk type.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the temporary bandwidth upgrade.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the instance for which you want to query the upgrade price.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The target instance type for the upgrade. We recommend that you call [DescribeResourcesModification](~~66187~~) to query the instance types available for upgrade in a specified zone.

parameters.name: InternetChargeType
parameters.description: The network billing method to convert to.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the temporary bandwidth upgrade.

parameters.name: SystemDisk.Category
parameters.description:
The category of the system disk. You need to specify this parameter only when you upgrade from a retired instance type to an available instance type and upgrade from a non-I/O optimized instance type to an I/O optimized instance type. For more information about instance types, see [Instance families](~~25378~~) and [Retired instance types](~~55263~~).

Valid values:

- cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
- cloud_ssd: standard SSD.

Default value: null.
